field_role.site_key: Exact source locationID stripped, together with exact normalized island. No approximate or geospatial matching; source fieldNumber only audited as an auxiliary source Event field, not used for primary site join.
field_role.other_islands: Enumerate Graciosa etc but do not pool with original core seven island native forests
field_role.event_Date_year_consistency: Prefer original numeric year; check leading year parsed from eventDate and report exact mismatch counts. Any malformed/unknown year is excluded only by source Event metadata, not species outcome.
field_role.source_sampling_method: Report frequency of source samplingProtocol verbatim labels without source site IDs; no post-response calibration of incompatible methods.

eligibility_gates.no_sampling_mode_equalization_yet: This is an Event-only inventory; DO NOT admit a biological guild or origin score until method-specific survey opportunities are separately frozen.

source_only_outputs: Exact original island-level source Event counts and site counts per campaign
Site-level same-source locationID intersection across B1/B2/B3 (counts only) plus stable SHA256 of eligible source site labels
Published-source samplingProtocol labels and per-phase Event sample counts
Original eventDate/year agreement and source record identifier completeness rates
Sample counts by site/campaign/method min/max and period-specific unmatched sites, anonymized, no source site identities
hard_stops: Duplicate original core Event keys or different source Event rows with same eventID
Insufficient source-locationID repeats across phases/7 islands
Incompatible source Event roles or invalid author source identifiers
prior_art_boundary: 2026 Pozsgai et al. BALA Sci Reports already covered stable abundance/biomass/richness, and individual/endemic species increases/decreases. v1.311 opens no species outcomes and makes no novel ecological claim.
